selectedIdea.title: A delivery without a landing
selectedIdea.description: Follow the handoff from sample capsule to onward spacecraft.
selectedIdea.rationale: Follow the handoff from sample capsule to onward spacecraft.
selectedIdea.evidence: About 20 minutes after the spacecraft released its sample capsule above Earth’s atmosphere, it fired its engines to divert its trajectory away from Earth.

synthesis.content:
### Central insight
Follow the handoff from sample capsule to onward spacecraft.
### Evidence
About 20 minutes after the spacecraft released its sample capsule above Earth’s atmosphere, it fired its engines to divert its trajectory away from Earth.
### Limits
Distinguish the capsule and the spacecraft.
